notes:
SakuraLauncher 0.2.2 beta

Fixes Windows startup paths for all Java Edition versions. Extended Windows paths are converted at the Java boundary for classpaths, assets, natives and game directories. The selected private Java runtime has a restricted DLL search path; system Java and user PATH are not inherited.

Validated on Windows with real Java 8, 17 and 21, including the official Minecraft 1.8 LWJGL Java/native binding. Launch argument regression passed for all 103 pinned stable versions. Existing worlds, players, instances and settings are preserved.

Full gameplay acceptance on the user's Windows PC remains pending. This is a beta, not certification of gameplay for all versions. Close active Minecraft sessions before applying the update.
